issue.title: Pi 集成：Google 模型未配置为 google-generative-ai，仍继承 openai-completions
issue.body:
使用 magpie-google-ai-studio 时，模型声明 api.npm="@ai-sdk/google"，但 Magpie 自动生成的 pi 配置仍继承 openai-completions，没有使用 google-generative-ai。

当前 pi 配置只为 Responses 和 Anthropic 覆盖模型协议，没有 Google 分支：
https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/8c68b6802aef3b1f17393b84f7d90e99d1104f32/internal/agent/agents.go#L517-L546

期望为具备 Gemini 调用能力的模型（包括 @ai-sdk/google 插件模型）生成 api="google-generative-ai"、baseUrl="<Magpie 网关地址>/v1beta"。请求仍经过 Magpie，并保留插件账号认证和自定义 fetch。

网关已有 /v1beta/models/{call...} 入口：
https://github.com/yetone/magpie/blob/8c68b6802aef3b1f17393b84f7d90e99d1104f32/internal/gateway/gateway.go#L737-L740

本次依据源码核对，未运行完整 pi 集成复现，也未验证具体字段丢失。建议补充配置生成和经网关调用插件的测试；不要求所有字段原样透传。

comments.body:
已在我的 fork 提交修复：[279e9bd1](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/279e9bd1c40823112cd854860dfe46f2e903ccfa)，分支 `fix/pi-google-api`。

问题有两层：生成 Pi 配置时没有 Gemini 分支；更早的 `magpieModels` 又把仅支持 Gemini/Code Assist 的模型能力丢掉了。现在这类模型会写入 `api: "google-generative-ai"` 和网关 `/v1beta` 地址。Pi、OmO、Prime Agent、StepCode 共用这条配置路径，已有配置正常 Sync 后也会修正；Pencil 和路由组保持原有协议选择。请求仍经网关及插件自己的认证/fetch，不把插件凭据写进 Pi。

回归测试在旧代码上对直接 Gemini 和四个客户端的 Google 插件模型均真实失败，修复后通过；相关 agent/gateway 测试带 `-race` 通过。另实际运行锁定版本的 Pi 1.2.0 SDK：读取生成的 models.json、向本地 `/v1beta/...:streamGenerateContent` 发请求，并解码 SSE 成功。插件路径测试也确认仍带插件账号认证。

没有连接真实 Google 账户，也未运行真实 Prime Agent/StepCode 客户端；上述实测使用本地服务。

Combined validation: these changes are included in [065f0c8f](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/065f0c8ffc9e30225f3d468ef41ec414aab75e02) on `fix/issue-batch-20261023`. At that exact commit, `go test -tags nogui ./... -count=1 -timeout=45m`, native/Linux/Windows vet and native/Linux/Windows builds all passed with Go 1.26.8, a temporary HOME and pinned Go caches (Linux host, umask 027). Cross-platform builds/vet are not Windows runtime tests. These full-suite results apply to the combined commit; the focused results above apply to the individual fix.

Ported in 7eb7fa540 (v0.1.2042), with credit to @skygunner, whose patch (279e9bd1 on `fix/pi-google-api`) this is.

What changes: a model served on Google's Gemini API (a custom provider's Gemini URL, a Google sign-in, or a plugin model that declares `@ai-sdk/google`, such as magpie-google-ai-studio's) is now written into Pi's `models.json` as `api: "google-generative-ai"` with `baseUrl: <gateway>/v1beta`. Requests still go through magpie and the plugin's own sign-in and fetch. The next sync rewrites models.json files written earlier. A model you set to Chat yourself, routing groups and Pencil keep their current API.

Two changes from the original patch:
- **StepCode stays on Chat for these models.** Step-Code (at 90a57820) registers only `anthropic-messages`, `openai-completions` and `openai-responses` in `packages/providers/src/compat.ts`. Its docs list `google-generative-ai`, but nothing implements it, so the patch would have broken Gemini models there.
- **Thinking levels Gemini doesn't name are hidden.** On `google-generative-ai`, pi-ai's `resolveGoogleThinkingLevel` throws on any level other than minimal, low, medium or high, so levels like xhigh and max are set to null in `thinkingLevelMap`.

Checked against the source: pi-ai 1.4.0 and OmO's senpi-ai treat a `baseUrl` as already holding the version (`apiVersion = ""`), and Prime Agent's `pa-ai` uses a model's `baseUrl` in place of the host and version.

What was run: the internal/agent and internal/gateway test packages, and the new tests, which fail on the old code. I also ran real Pi 1.4.0 in a sandbox against a local fake Gemini upstream. `pi -p` got the reply, its session recorded `google-generative-ai`, and the upstream got `/v1beta/models/gemini-3-flash:streamGenerateContent`.

Not tried: a real Google account or plugin sign-in, and real OmO and Prime Agent binaries.

I'm leaving this open until @XYenon confirms that it works with magpie-google-ai-studio.

issue.title: agent: Aside's models.json still asks Gemini models on google-generative-ai, which fails if Aside passes its own fetch (sibling of 2f5a3f1c0)

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
2f5a3f1c0 (v0.1.2187) left this sibling unchanged and named it in its body; this issue tracks it.

**The rule:** pi-ai's Google adapter throws before it sends when a request carries its own `fetch`: "Custom fetch is not supported by the Google Generative AI adapter" (`api/google-generative-ai.js`, pi-ai 0.83.0 and 1.4.0). Raft runs Pi's SDK on Pi's folder and passes such a fetch, so since v0.1.2042 (#3282) every Gemini model failed there (yunfei9958 on X). 2f5a3f1c0 keeps Gemini models on Chat in Pi's `models.json` (`piAsked` in `internal/agent/agents.go`).

**Aside isn't covered.** Aside also runs Pi's SDK, on its own `~/.aside/u/<account>/models.json`. magpie writes its block with `magpieProviderJSONAt("pi", "aside", …)` (`internal/agent/aside_native.go`). `piAsked("aside", …)` doesn't drop the Gemini API, so a Gemini-capable model is still written as `api: "google-generative-ai"` at the gateway's `/v1beta`. `piOffered("aside", …)` hides the thinking levels to match. If Aside passes a fetch the way Raft does, every Gemini model fails in Aside with the same error.

**What was checked:**
- The `aside` CLI isn't installed on the dev machine, and there is no `~/.aside`.
- npm has no matching package: `aside` on npm is an unrelated 0.0.1 placeholder, and `aside-codemode` is an extension, not the app.
- No public source was found. So it is unknown whether Aside's model runtime passes `fetch` (or `streamSimple`/`stream` options with `fetch`) to pi-ai.

**What would settle it:**
1. With a real Aside, connect magpie in a sandbox HOME and pick a Gemini model (a Gemini custom provider, a Google or Antigravity sign-in, or a plugin model declaring `@ai-sdk/google`). Send one prompt (`aside repl` or the app). The error above means it is affected. A reply, with the gateway logging `/v1beta/models/…:streamGenerateContent`, means it is fine.
2. Or, from Aside's bundled JS, grep for `fetch:` passed into the model runtime's stream options (as `installProviderHttpClient` does in Raft's daemon), and for the pi-ai version it bundles.

If it is affected: add `"aside"` to `piAsked`. `TestPiFolderKeepsGeminiOnChatForRaft` shows the test shape. If it isn't: write that down in `piAsked`'s comment and close this issue.
